fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a process spawned by the terminal service server process (this could be an indicator for an exploitation of CVE-2019-0708)
fields.name: Terminal Service Process Spawn
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.cmdline contains "\\svchost.exe" and src.process.cmdline contains "termsvcs") and (not ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\rdpclip.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\System32\\csrss.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\System32\\wininit.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\System32\\winlogon.exe") or not (tgt.process.image.path matches "\.*")))))
